# TDPdf v1.29.3.0

**The text box you couldn't move — root-caused from real fleet telemetry, not a guess this time.**

The last two releases tried to fix "the text box can't be moved or resized" by auto-selecting it once you finished typing and pressed Enter. That helped, but it turned out to miss the actual problem: fleet telemetry from a real 1.29.2.0 session showed someone placing a text box, then clicking near it *before typing anything*, trying to nudge it into a better spot — and every one of those clicks quietly killed the box and started a new empty one at the new position. Clicking inside the box only moves the text cursor; there was never anything to actually grab and drag while it was still open for editing.

The live text editor now has a small round drag handle at its top-left corner. Click and drag it to reposition the box — before you've typed a single character, exactly the moment this was needed.

## The Rotate button, actually visible this time

Last release added Rotate to the toolbar and reported it fixed — except the fix before that (splitting the toolbar into two columns to stop buttons overlapping) had made the file-operations group, where Rotate landed, scroll horizontally instead. The math: at the app's own default window size the two button groups together need roughly 1400px, well past what fits — so that group was already scrolled past its visible edge before Rotate was ever added to it, and a thin auto-hiding scrollbar on a toolbar isn't somewhere anyone thinks to look.

The toolbar now wraps to a second row instead of scrolling or overlapping. Every button — Rotate included — is always on screen, at any window width, with nothing to scroll or hunt for.
